summary: SLM Corp filed an 8-K to disclose the closing of a $500M public offering of 6.495% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2032 under its existing Form S-3 shelf. The notes bear fixed interest for five years then float at Benchmark plus 271 bps, with standard redemption and change-of-control put rights. Proceeds will fund the purchase of SLM's 3.125% senior notes due 2026 plus fees. This is a straightforward refinancing debt issuance, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return is involved. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction.
